safety_review.findings: Fresh review by a non-author of every reply in all 13 banks, every option, all 3 alternatives, Thai and English, read against every question variant of its bank. Sources: the case's own review names the Thoracic Society of Thailand COPD guideline 2565, WHO IMAI District Clinician Manual 2011 and BTS/ICS AHRF 2016; this reviewer could not open the Thai guideline text online and checked against BTS/ICS AHRF 2016 (Thorax 71 Suppl 2) and NHS and Irish Thoracic Society NIV protocols derived from it (NIV at pH <7.35 with PaCO2 >6.5 kPa, repeat gas at 1 hour and no later than 2 hours), and REDUCE/GOLD summaries (prednisolone 40 mg for 5 days; antibiotic on Anthonisen cardinal symptoms).
